sections.description: Internal Kingdom tool for managing Sermons, Events, and Calendar views (with recurrence).
sections.changelog:
• Added a built-in template system for Sermon Speaker, Sermon Series, Church, and All Events archives, as well as Single Sermon and Single Event views. These pages now use the plugin’s built-in templates and no longer rely on Elementor templates.
  • Select

in the Appearance settings to force and override system-saved values.
  • Updated the sermon taxonomy URL structure for cleaner, more consistent links: sermon-speaker/speaker-name → sermon/speaker/speaker-name; sermon-series/series-name → sermon/series/series-name; sermon-churches/church-name → sermon/church/church-name.
  • Existing links remain compatible and automatically resolve to the new URL structure.
  • Added options to set custom Sermons and Events pages for their respective back buttons. If unset, they will default to the /sermons and /events pages.
  • Improved the designs of the Single Event view and Single Event widget.
  • The Events Calendar is now rendered server-side to improve loading time and prevent an empty calendar from appearing on the initial load.
